description: Two-page product datasheet (fictitious flow meter) typeset with Typst 0.15 (Inter 9.5 pt, justified and hyphenated, shaded specification table, a bar chart drawn as Typst rectangles, a footnote), then edited with PyMuPDF 2.1. All edits are content-stream edits and none adds an annotation. The before file has Typst's two invisible /Link annotations for the footnote (marker to footnote and back); the redaction of the footnote text also removed the back-link, so the after file keeps only the link on the in-text marker. Redaction (no fill) + re-inserted text: the running header 'Rev. B' becomes 'Rev. C' on both pages (Helvetica 8 pt); the line 'Document no. DS-UFM80-004' is removed and set again in Inter (embedded again by PyMuPDF), right-aligned to the right margin; the minimum operating temperature '−20' (U+2212) is re-typed as '-10' with an ASCII hyphen-minus because Helvetica has no U+2212; the heading '3 Electrical connection' is re-typed with the same words in Times-Bold (base-14) instead of Inter Bold; the footnote text on p. 2 is redacted, leaving its separator rule and the superscript marker in the body text. Drawn: the DN100 bar of the response-time chart is lengthened from 1.6 s to 2.1 s by drawing a longer filled rectangle of the same colour over it. Added with insert_htmlbox: a firmware note in the white space under the installation list. Consequences, not listed: re-typed text sits at the end of each content stream; the dangling footnote marker '1' after 'motor cables' is left as it was.

truth.note: Running header revision letter, p. 2 (same edit as p. 1).

Same words, same typeface and size (Inter re-embedded by PyMuPDF, so the PDF font name differs from Typst's 'Inter-Regular-Identity-H' subset), moved from the left margin to the right margin, about 332 pt to the right.
Operating temperature '−20 °C to +60 °C' -> '-10 °C to +60 °C'. Old sign is U+2212, new sign is ASCII '-'; both are negative.
Chart bar DN100 longer (1.6 s -> 2.1 s); no value labels on the bars, the axis is unchanged.

Font substitution on unchanged text: heading re-typed in Times-Bold instead of Inter Bold, same size and baseline. newRect is the narrower Times-Bold text (ends at x 174.2; the Inter Bold original ended at x 191.1).

truth.old: Use shielded twisted-pair cable and connect the shield
truth.note: Footnote text (with its number) removed at the page bottom; the in-text marker stays.

truth.new: 2.4 or later is required for the low
truth.note: Note added with insert_htmlbox (Nimbus Sans 9 pt, 'Note:' bold) between the installation list and section 5. Snippet avoids 'firmware', 'flow' and 'off': PDF.js expands the htmlbox ligatures, pdftotext keeps them as U+FB01/U+FB02/U+FB00.
